{{Quote|<nowiki>Bounty hunter = Terrin Sandafar // Terrin = born on Alderaan // Terrin = served in Republic army</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" />}}
'''Terrin Sandafar''' was a [[Alderaanian/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] for one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before becoming a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Sandafar was hired<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> by the [[Verre Sydia's husband|husband]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Verre Sydia]]<ref name="The Truth Comes Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Truth Comes Out}}</ref> to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Alderaanian [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Eckhorn Baliss]]<ref name="Eckhorn's List">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}}</ref> in [[3663 BBY]].<ref name="Baliss date">The conversations with [[T7-O1]] in Act I take place during [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]]. {{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}} establishes that [[Eckhorn Baliss]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] twnety [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior&mdash;in [[3663 BBY]].</ref> The husband was an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]],<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" /> and he had learned that his fellow spy Baliss had a list of Imperial traitors in the Republic.<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />

In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when Sydia's husband discovered that [[Shafu]]&mdash;an informant for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]<ref name="Slaver's Redemption">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Slaver's Redemtption}}</ref>&mdash;was investigating Baliss, he had Sandafar kill Shafu by detonating his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Shafu's Report">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Shafu's Report}}</ref> Sandafar was killed not long afterward by her employer in a rigged explosion on her own ship. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and Shafu's former partner, the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], uncovered Sandafar's involvement<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> a [[3643 BBY|decade later]],<ref name="Time" /> and traced her payments back to the Senator's husband.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terrin Sandafar is mentioned in optional conversations with the Jedi Knight companion [[T7-O1]] in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> She was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, on T7-O1's page in the Biographies section of the game's official site, which featured an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] sentence that translated as "The Exploding Starships Conspiracy".<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|t7-o1|T7-O1}}</ref>
